name_note: GTDB places in this genus genomes that NCBI labels Hominisplanchenecus, Faecalicatena or Ruminococcus, so the GTDB genus is broader than the literature genus Hominisplanchenecus.

sentences.text: Hominisplanchenecus is a bacterial genus detected in human faecal samples by sequencing-based gut microbiota profiling.
In older Korean adults, a study reported that Hominisplanchenecus was found only in the Alzheimer's disease group among the cognitive groups compared.
A study of stool samples reported Hominisplanchenecus among five dominant genera identified as potential biomarkers for predicting aneurysmal subarachnoid haemorrhage outcomes.
A study reported that increased abundance of Hominisplanchenecus was positively associated with lupus disease severity, alongside gut dysbiosis findings.
